delivery.ciSource: 流水线已完成最终验证及 PR 发布；不代表人工合并。
delivery.qaSummary: 办公设备借用与归还管理系统完整浏览器验收通过。B01-B06 全部实际提交并验证：设备台账与借用记录可打开，示例含可借用/正常借出/逾期未还/历史已归还，顶部三数（总数/借出/逾期）与明细一致；新增设备刷新后仍在、改名后可按名称搜索，重复编号与空编号/空名称被拒绝且原记录未被覆盖；借出借用人/用途/预计归还保存正确、借出数+1，缺字段不产生记录；已借出未归还不能再次借出且原记录不变；归还后设备恢复可借、原记录保留归还时间，重复归还不产生记录也不改写归还时间，可再次借出且新旧记录并存；借用人搜索与未归还/已归还筛选正确、逾期有明显提示，归还逾期设备后借出数与逾期数各减一，刷新后一致。未发现控制台或页面错误。

delivery.acceptanceRequirements:
B01. 登录后能打开设备台账和借用记录，示例数据中有可借用、正常借出、逾期未还和历史已归还记录；顶部三个数量与明细一致。
B02. 新增设备后刷新仍存在；修改名称后搜索能找到。重复资产编号或空资产编号、空设备名称不能保存，已有记录不被覆盖。
B03. 对可借用设备登记一笔借出，借用人、用途和预计归还日期保存正确，台账同步显示借出中，当前借出数增加一。缺少借用人或预计归还日期时不能产生借出记录。
B04. 对已借出且未归还设备再次尝试登记借出，操作被拒绝，原借用人和借用记录不变，没有生成第二笔未归还记录。
B05. 归还后设备恢复可借用、原记录保留归还时间；再次尝试归还不产生重复记录且不改写原归还时间。该设备随后可再次借出，新旧记录分别保留。
B06. 借用人搜索和未归还／已归还筛选结果正确；示例逾期记录有明显提示。将一台逾期未还设备归还后，逾期数和借出数各减少一，刷新页面后数字和状态仍一致。

evaluation.summary: 本轮基础框架总体可用：db 的迁移/种子与 Collection Builder、Repository 的过滤与事务、app-server/service-provider 的 provider+路由装配、app-client 的路由与 DataTable 指引，都能让 Agent 按示例完成办公设备借用/归还需求，四个能力单元均给出了非 null 评分。主要未决问题是通用库未公开唯一约束冲突的稳定判定（应用只能按驱动错误串分支），以及指引未说明“需求强制的演示/时间相对数据”应放在哪一层。覆盖限制：实现日志 agent-implement.jsonl 缺失、@nocobase/api-client 未随快照采集、当前模型无法解析 PNG 故未做视觉复核。

modules.name: 数据库集合、迁移与种子（@nocobase/db + nocobase-db Skill）

requirements.actualUsage: Agent 的迁移文件与 Skill 示例结构一致：createCollection + string/datetime + unique('assetNo') + foreignKey + index(...)。

requirements.need: 安装即带可借出/正常借出/逾期/已归还的可复现示例数据，且重复运行不产生重复行。

requirements.need: 迁移/种子只执行 pending、失败不半写、可重复 apply。
requirements.responsibility: 框架保证只执行 pending、任务锁、默认事务与历史记录。
requirements.recommendedUsage: pnpm db:apply；transaction 默认 true，见 nocobase-db SKILL §2。
requirements.actualUsage: 实现日志缺失，无法确认 Agent 的具体执行过程；仅从应用文件与验收通过推断使用了 db:apply。

requirementFit.reason: 迁移与种子职责边界清晰，builder 公开了建表所需全部结构操作，应用迁移与 Skill 示例几乎一一对应；种子仓储与事务足以实现幂等安装数据。

agentFriendliness.reason: nocobase-db SKILL 与 app-development 的 migrations.md 均被注入实现上下文，§2/§3 给出可直接照抄的迁移与种子示例，应用产出与示例高度一致。

design.reason: 迁移（结构）与种子（数据）分层、不可变与自包含规则、任务锁与 checksum 历史等抽象边界清楚，公开 API 与类型对应完整。

requirements.need: 重复 assetNo 被拒绝并返回可识别的业务错误。
requirements.responsibility: 框架应提供稳定的唯一冲突判定或错误码；应用把冲突映射为业务错误。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 未确认；公开 RepositoryErrorCode 无唯一冲突码，能识别冲突的 isUniqueConstraintViolation 只存在于 database/internal。

requirements.need: 归还需幂等：重复归还不得改写 returnedAt，也不得产生新记录。
requirements.responsibility: 框架提供空值过滤与条件更新；应用实现幂等规则。
requirements.recommendedUsage: filter.date('returnedAt').empty() + 条件 updateMany + updatedCount 检查。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 用 filter.number('id').eq + filter.date('returnedAt').empty() 条件更新，并仅在 updatedCount>0 时恢复设备可用。

requirementFit.reason: 过滤/排序、条件更新、事务与 updatedCount 都在公开 API 内直接满足本次查询与并发/幂等需求，应用实现无能力缺口。

usability.reason: FilterBuilder 与 Repository 方法一致、类型完整，空 scope 会明确报错；扣分在唯一冲突没有公开判定，业务错误映射需自写驱动分支。

agentFriendliness.reason: SKILL §4 明确 builder/JSON AST 语义、updateMany 空 scope 与权限默认值，应用查询与断言写法均可在文档中找到依据；唯一冲突判定需自行摸索。

design.reason: repository-input 把过滤/排序 AST 与 Repository 分层，返回值显式区分 record 与 updatedCount，错误类型带 code/path/collection 等结构化字段。

reliability.reason: 阅读实现：normalizeMutationFilter 对空 scope 抛 INVALID_FILTER，updateMany 返回适配器真实 updatedCount，兑现公开约定；唯一冲突只在 upsert 重试中被吸收，普通写入透传驱动错误。

findings.detail: db 的公开 API（defineMigration/defineSeed、builder 的 string/datetime/unique/foreignKey/index）与 nocobase-db SKILL §2/§3 示例一一对应；应用两个迁移与示例结构几乎一致，seed 用 SeedContext.repository 先查后写实现幂等。

findings.title: 通用库未公开唯一约束冲突的稳定判定，应用只能按驱动错误串分支
findings.detail: 公开 RepositoryErrorCode 没有唯一约束冲突码；能识别 unique 冲突的 isUniqueConstraintViolation 位于 database/internal/，index.js 注释声明 internal 不导出，adapter 只在 upsertOne 的并发重试里使用它，普通 createOne 直接抛出驱动原始错误。应用因此手写 isUniqueViolation，检查 '23505'/'SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE' 与 message 正则。
findings.impact: 跨方言或驱动升级时业务方需维护驱动错误分支，漏判会把 409 类业务冲突变成 500 或误报。
findings.suggestedChange: 导出稳定的唯一冲突判定（如 isUniqueConstraintViolation），或在 RepositoryErrorCode 增加冲突码并让 create/update 路径包装抛出。

diagnosis.trigger: 在同一表对带唯一约束字段写入重复值（如重复 assetNo）时，createOne 抛出底层驱动错误。
diagnosis.expected: 框架提供公开且跨方言稳定的唯一约束冲突判定或错误码。
diagnosis.actual: 仅有 internal 的 isUniqueConstraintViolation 实现，公开 RepositoryError 类型无对应码，createOne 透传原始驱动错误。
diagnosis.workaround: 应用按 code 23505 / SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE 与 message 正则自行判定，再映射为业务错误与 409。
diagnosis.acceptance: 对重复唯一值执行 createOne 时框架抛出公开错误码（或提供公开谓词并在文档说明），应用无需依赖驱动错误串即可判定冲突。

findings.title: 指引未说明“需求强制的演示/时间相对数据”应放在哪一层
findings.detail: nocobase-db SKILL §2 明确“a seed is never sample or demonstration content”，而本任务要求安装即含逾期等演示数据以支撑验收；migrations.md 又要求种子固定可复现、no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields。指引没有给出“需求强制的演示数据/时间相对数据”的推荐落点与可复现写法，应用只能把相对 new Date() 的演示数据写进 seed 并自行注释取舍。
findings.impact: 不同 Agent 可能把演示数据放进迁移、生产种子或不写，导致验收状态不稳定，也容易与“种子不可变/可复现”规则产生表面冲突。
findings.suggestedChange: 在 migrations.md 或 nocobase-db SKILL 增补一节，区分生产安装数据与需求强制的演示数据，明确推荐放置位置与允许的相对时间写法。

diagnosis.trigger: 需求要求交付含逾期/正常借出的可演示数据，同时要求重复安装可复现。

evidence.observation: 公开包 API 导出 defineMigration、defineSeed、createMigrator、createSeeder 及其类型，未见唯一约束判定。
MigrationDefinition 约定 name/transaction/irreversible/shouldRun/up/down。
SeedContext.repository 注释说明“安装数据”以 Collection 逻辑字段写入；SeedDefinition 只有 name/transaction/run。
CollectionDefinitionBuilder 提供 unique/foreignKey/index。
§2 说明迁移建结构、seed 插入运行所需记录且“a seed is never sample or demonstration content”，并给出 createCollection/unique/index 的迁移示例。
迁移/种子绝对规则：自包含、合并后不可变、seed 按稳定业务值幂等（upsertOne）、默认事务。
evidence.excerpt:
The rules are absolute, because these files are history that has already run on other machines:

- **Self-contained.** Spell out every table, field, index, constraint and metadata operation in the file. Never import a Collection definition, model, registry or shared constant that keeps evolving — that silently changes both the behavior and the checksum of something already applied.
- **Immutable once merged.** Check with `git log -- <file>` if unsure. Before the branch is merged you may correct the file in place; after it, every change is a new, later file. Never hard-code a previous checksum to make an edited migration look untouched. Correcting it in place changes nothing on its own — it is recorded as executed, so a plain apply skips it and the database keeps the schema the old file produced. `pnpm db:redo` rolls the latest batch back and applies it again.
- **The file name body matches `name`**, and the name is unique across every source in the application.
- **Declare `irreversible: true`** when there is no real reverse operation, instead of writing a `down()` that quietly does nothing.
- **A seed is idempotent**, keyed on a stable business value backed by a unique constraint, so a repeated run is a no-op — `upsertOne` is the direct way to express that. A seed context has no `builder` at all, and a seed has no rollback or truncate behavior.

A backfill belongs in the migration that makes it necessary, using `query` from the same context — not in a seed.

Both run inside a transaction by default. `transaction: false` opts out, and a failure then leaves partial work behind with no history record, so take it only when the operation genuinely cannot run in one.

evidence.excerpt:
Migrations under `database/main/migrations/` are the application's schema history. Seeds under `database/main/seeds/` insert records the application requires to run. Migrations create structure. Seeds never do.

`database/tsconfig.json` extends the server configuration so editor tooling and ESLint recognize migrations and seeds as Node source. Keep it in place when adding connection directories.

## Running

```bash
pnpm db:apply
```

This applies pending migrations and then pending seeds for `database.default`, including registered plugins, ordered by name across all sources. Both halves run only what is pending, so on an already-migrated database it applies seeds alone. The template defaults to `main`. Plugin migrations, seeds and runtime default reads/writes always use this same connection; changing `database.default` changes the application system database.

Seeds are the second half of that run, so the structure a seed writes into must already exist from an earlier migration. Keep seed data fixed and reproducible — no current timestamps or random values in identifying fields — and never let a repeat run silently overwrite data a user has edited.

evidence.observation: §4：filter/values/select/sort 接受 builder 或 JSON AST；updateMany/deleteMany 拒绝空 scope；Repository 不应用权限。
evidence.excerpt:
Resolve the manager once — in a route factory, or as a constructor dependency of a service — not inside every handler. `db.repository()`, `db.query()`, `db.builder()`, `db.collections()` and `db.transaction()` take the connection name as their last argument and use the default connection when it is omitted, so single-connection code never names one.

`filter`, `values`, `select` and `sort` each accept a builder callback or the equivalent serializable JSON AST, and mean the same thing either way. They do not accept a shorthand string array such as `['id', 'name']` or `['-createdAt']`. Field names are Collection logical names, never column names. A write returns a result object — the record is `result.record`, alongside `result.version` and the created relation targets — rather than the record itself. `findMany` is awaited for an array or iterated asynchronously to consume a large result incrementally.

The methods are `findOne`, `findMany`, `count`, `exists`, `aggregate`, `groupBy`, `createOne`, `createMany`, `updateOne`, `updateMany`, `upsertOne`, `deleteOne` and `deleteMany`; `describeMutation` and `validateMutation` report capabilities and pre-validate input, and `withPolicy` returns a scoped Repository.

Boundaries that are easy to get wrong:

- `findOne` takes the first match; `updateOne` and `deleteOne` require exactly one; `upsertOne` requires a unique equality condition.
- `updateMany` and `deleteMany` refuse an empty scope. Pass `all: true` only when the task explicitly calls for every row — never to make an error go away.
- `createMany` and `updateMany` do not accept nested relation writes. `createOne` accepts `create` and `connect` on a relation, not the full set.
- `disconnect` detaches; `delete` removes the target record. A relation target update or delete stays inside the current parent record's scope.
- Repository does not apply the application's permissions. A route handler decides what the caller may see and change _before_ anything reaches `filter`, `values` or `select`. `writePolicy` defaults to `true` for an internal Repository and `false` for one reached from an API route, so a route-facing Repository needs an explicit allow list.
- Do not assume an `id` exists, and do not infer a field's type, primary key or auto-increment from its name.

## Every route owns its own security

**Mounting under `/api` does not authenticate anything.** `/api` is a location. A route with no `auth.required()` is public regardless of where it mounts.

Never depend on middleware installed by another route, or on the order contributions happen to be registered in. Contribution order changes when a plugin is added, and a route protected only by someone else's middleware silently becomes public.

`auth.required()` rejects anonymous requests with `401`. `auth.optional()` attaches the session when present without rejecting.

evidence.excerpt:
## F Foundations

**F1 [Must] Color uses only semantic tokens**; do not write literal color values:

| Purpose                                    | Use                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Page background                            | `bg-background`                                         |
| Cards, panels                              | `bg-card`                                               |
| Muted areas, secondary backgrounds         | `bg-muted`                                              |
| Overlays (dialogs, menus)                  | `bg-popover` (built into the components)                |
| Body text                                  | `text-foreground`                                       |
| Secondary text, descriptions, placeholders | `text-muted-foreground`                                 |
| Borders, dividers                          | `border-border`                                         |
| Primary actions                            | The default button style (`bg-primary`)                 |
| Destructive                                | `text-destructive`; buttons use `variant='destructive'` |

Do not use literal colors such as `bg-white`, `text-gray-500`, `#1677ff` or `rgb(…)`.

**F2 [Must] Font sizes come from the scale**: PageHeader provides the page title; section titles use `text-base font-medium`; body text, tables and forms use the components' default size (`text-sm`); helper text uses `text-sm text-muted-foreground` or `text-xs`. Do not use arbitrary values such as `text-[13px]`.

**F3 [Must] Spacing comes from the scale**: `gap-6` between sections (PageContainer already provides it); `p-4` or `p-6` padding inside cards; `gap-2` between related controls; FieldGroup's default spacing between form fields. Do not use arbitrary values such as `mt-[7px]`.

**F4 [Must] Radius and shadow use the component defaults**; when you need a custom one, use only utility classes such as `rounded-lg` and `shadow-sm`.

**F5 [Must] All icons come from lucide-react**; the button controls the size of an icon inside it, and a standalone icon uses `size-4`.

**F6 [Must] Everything is clearly readable in both the light and dark themes**. Using only semantic tokens satisfies this automatically; you do not need `dark:` prefixes.
